title: Quarterly roadmap assembly kit for Hosted API & Model Catalog (Q2)
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Q2 Roadmap
description: Create a reusable "assembly kit" and execution plan for the Q2 roadmap that ties Hosted API product priorities to the Model Catalog cadence and OKRs. The kit includes decision templates for scope trade-offs, canary and rollback windows, staffing recommendations, observable milestones, and a communication cadence template for Eng/Design/Sales/CS. Deliverables: 1) Master roadmap artifact (timeboxed lanes and owners), 2) OKR-mapped initiative briefs, 3) Canary schedule and gating criteria, 4) Lightweight runbook for cross-team orchestration.
objectives: Map top 3 Hosted API customer scenarios to model-catalog release lanes
Establish measurable OKR signals for model health, latency, and cost per 1k tokens
Create canary gating templates that are runnable with existing test harness and console dashboards
initiatives: Latency & throughput baseline alignments across hosted endpoints
Model rotation policy and automated rollback proposal
Canary & staged rollout playbook for model catalog swaps
Dashboard signal contract between Runtime and Console teams
milestones: 2026-03-15: Draft assembly kit and lane mapping complete
2026-03-29: Canary gating criteria finalized and automation tickets opened
2026-04-01: Roadmap artifact published to Confluence and stakeholder sync
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap artifact includes owners, estimated effort, and release lanes for each initiative
OKR mapping shows clear signals and measurement queries with dashboards linked
Canary schedule has step-by-step gating tests, rollback criteria, and automation links
Stakeholder signoff from Runtime, Console, and Customer Success documented
risks: Model compatibility regressions during rotation could increase latency for critical tenants
Insufficient observability signals to detect quality regressions at canary scale
Resource contention on Dedicated capacity for scheduled canaries
Timeline slippage due to dependency on infra kernel updates
mitigation_plan: Add pre-launch fuzz-evals linked to each model swap and require pass rates before canary
Reserve burst capacity windows in Dedicated pool for canaries; coordinate with capacity planning
Create temporary fallback routes to lower-cost/low-latency variants for high-risk endpoints
Block infra kernel upgrades in canary windows and schedule maintenance outside rollout lanes
